metadata_encoding: title, tier and model_chain are explicit keys in notes to preserve all 16 original template columns.

F1.title: Data audit and AB-blocked validation
F1.filter: H-soft rows only from main_outer_0..4; row_index unique; 02 training domain only; gap=0 metal; gap>0 nonmetal.
F1.aggregation: 11256 unique rows; 10824 metal; 432 nonmetal; 1608 directed AB groups; 128 V<=2; zero observed V=0.
F1.required_annotations: N=11256; metal=96.16%; eps=2; V=0 observed count=0; 1608 AB groups; train/test AB disjoint.
F1.claim_limits: Do not merge repeated route rows. Zero observed V=0 applies to 02 only, not to hidden holdout. 03 is development selection, not independent final test.

F2.title: Near-positive enrichment under fixed AB blocking
F2.filter: H-soft: protocol=outer and domains main_outer_0..4; baselines: protocol=baseline and domains baseline_0..4; no inner/by_X/stress/pooled rows.
F2.aggregation: Sum fold-specific hits; equal mean of fold-specific EF. At k=20 total budget=100. Do not compute pooled Top-20.
F2.required_annotations: Event V<=2; k per fold; H-soft 68/100 and EF=62.1024; Ridge 10/100; mean 1/100; random 0/100; random expectation EF=1; fold-specific N/M/h and unadjusted p_uniform@20.
F2.claim_limits: Observed random curve is not replaced by theoretical EF=1. No p-value averaging or invented pooled test. p_uniform is a descriptive uniform-null reference after development selection.

F3.title: Error contributions and the regression-screening trade-off
F3.filter: Four registered numeric candidates plus additive_ridge and mean for MSE; Pareto eligibility exactly the four rows of regression_pareto.csv. Pure screening NA values excluded; nested duplicates not double counted.
F3.aggregation: Metal and nonmetal SSE/total N sum to pooled RMSE squared; never plot conditional class MSE as contributions.
F3.required_annotations: H-soft RMSE=4.6011; MSE contributions=18.2920+2.8781; EF=62.1024; registered-menu frontier; conditional H-soft minus R-log EF interval crosses zero.
F3.claim_limits: No RMSE assigned to pure classifiers/rankers. Pareto dominance is limited to the registered regression menu, not a universal or causal claim.

A1.title: Residual structure by X family
A1.filter: All seven X families; frozen H-soft external OOF residual summaries; preserve family order.
A1.aggregation: Use stored values; bias=vhat-V; q95_absolute is an empirical residual quantile.
A1.required_annotations: n=1608 per X; zero-bias line; signed bias definition; q95(|vhat-V|).
A1.claim_limits: Residual quantiles are not calibrated prediction intervals or bootstrap model dispersion. Separate panels avoid mixing signed bias and positive scales.

A2.title: External OOF probability calibration diagnostics
A2.filter: External OOF calibrated score for the four probability routes; no H-soft -vhat used as probability. Diagnostic intercept/slope from fold=pooled rows only.
A2.aggregation: Presentation-only 10 fixed equal-width bins over [0,1] from stored OOF probabilities; count-weighted means; empty bins omitted and identified. Use existing diagnostic coefficients; fit nothing.
A2.required_annotations: Event V<=2; ideal y=x; N=11256 and positives=128; bin counts; stored intercept/slope/Brier; S-eps slope=1.7617; within-fold versus pooled Top-20 overlap note.
A2.claim_limits: No new logistic/Platt/isotonic fit. Coefficients and reliability curves are diagnostic, not new selection rules. Pooled ranking diagnostics do not replace fold-specific EF.

A3.title: Nominal-candidate rank and surrogate decision regret
A3.filter: Four pools; all 20 pre-existing members; nominal candidate La|Ti|NO2; fixed tie hash.
A3.aggregation: Use all 80 member records and stored quantiles; report min/max ranks and the descriptive 0.1 regret tolerance.
A3.required_annotations: 20 members per pool; pool 08 rank range 1-72; forward/reverse regret; tolerance=0.1 (descriptive, not physical); no pool passes the plateau rule.
A3.claim_limits: Regret is surrogate-table cost, not true-V regret. Identity rotation alone is not instability severity; no tiny-cost claim; no truth labels read.

A4.title: Split-half averaging and decision stability
A4.filter: bagged_half10 and single_member; 1000 fixed complementary splits of the same 20 members.
A4.aggregation: Use stored means; regret p50/p95 labels are descriptive split dispersion, not confidence limits. Single-member reference is the average of all 100 cross-half pairs per split.
A4.required_annotations: 1000 splits / 20 shared members; bagged_half10 versus single_member; pool 11/12 agreement=0.192/0.174; dependent splits; surrogate scale.
A4.claim_limits: This is 10-versus-10 stability evidence, not 1000 independent experiments or verified accuracy of the future mean20 table. No P23 retraining or QUBO solve.

A5.title: Protocol-level extrapolation stress diagnostics
A5.filter: Only registered R-log and S-eps stress results; three distinct protocols; no substitution as final H-soft validation.
A5.aggregation: Use stored summaries and valid evaluation counts: element 5/5; target 3/3; xleave 29/35 for EF. Undefined M=0 cases remain undefined.
A5.required_annotations: protocol-level evidence, not final-model; valid EF counts; method names; protocol-specific N/M/budget scope; no zero fill for undefined EF.
A5.claim_limits: No cross-protocol ease ranking from EF magnitudes: populations, prevalence and total budgets differ. Element evaluation repeats compositions; no independent-row CI.

A6.title: Feature additions and reverse ablations within model routes
A6.filter: R-log feature F0/F3 plus outer R-log F4=F3+E1; H-soft minus_electronic/minus_geometry/minus_xstats against full H-soft.
A6.aggregation: Use stored means and corrected paired_AB_bootstrap_5000 EF_macro@20 intervals; exclude legacy pooled Top-20 intervals.
A6.required_annotations: Separate route headers; F4 displayed as F3+E1; existing 5000 paired AB bootstrap draws; conditional exploratory intervals; zero difference line.
A6.claim_limits: Do not connect R-log and H-soft into one feature ladder. No new fits, bootstrap draws or selection. Intervals condition on fixed OOF and prior selection and are not multiplicity-adjusted.
